## Contracts and placement limit

Movement now sweeps full actor extents against raised bench/pad volumes and the bench's inverse cut faces. A retained overlap permits non-closing escape, with each tangent rechecked against adjacent solids. Default physical terrain receives these volumes; caller-supplied local floors do not. Diver and hull support lifts validate their full vertical path. Public queries, state/schema, renderer, camera, terrain heights and input remain unchanged.

Historical `clearance` deliberately remains a placement query with its old centre-floor behavior. Root inspected its callers in vehicles, carrier, recovery, modules and codec, plus `hullClearance`/movement. Module and recovery eligibility checks inspect existing poses; migration must preserve its old policy. A safe upright Dart envelope contains its ordinary exit footprint: lateral offset 3.1 + diver radius 0.34 = 3.44 m, below the 3.6 m hull bound; exit top 0.2 + 0.95 = 1.15 m, below hull height 2.1 m. Carrier entry/exit points likewise lie within its broader upright envelope. This is a source-level containment argument for safe hulls, not proof of arbitrary historical/seeded placements or all future construction paths.

An already overlapping historical hull or direct placement API can still admit terrain-footprint overlap. That disclosed limitation does not invalidate this bounded movement fix or require changing historical migration before composed play. It remains explicit input to complete-batch review and M2-B's earned placement/launch/recovery work. No claim that every placement path is fixed or safe. Any reproduced live-action blocker receives focused implementation ownership; no silent waiver.
